# TrackingApi.g.swift

**Path:** `ios/Classes/TrackingApi.g.swift` · **Layer:** iOS native (**generated by Pigeon, do not edit**)

## Purpose
The iOS side of the channel contract defined in `pigeons/tracking_api.dart`. Regenerate it with `dart run pigeon --input pigeons/tracking_api.dart` after changing the contract; never edit the generated file by hand.

## What it contains
| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| `PigeonError(code:message:details:)` | The error type every native failure must use (see `TrackingErrors.swift`). |
| `NativePermission`, `NativeTrackingState` | Enums: permission status and engine state. |
| `EngineConfig` | How the native engine measures distance (thresholds, PDR policy, Kalman, stop detector). |
| `NativeGpsQuality`, `NativeDistance` | GPS quality and the distance block (`totalMeters, gpsMeters, gapBridgeMeters, pdrMeters, pendingPdrMeters, movingTimeMs, isStopped, speedMps, lastAcceptedFixAtMs`). |
| `NativeFix` | One raw fix: `sessionId, segmentId, seq, timeMs, elapsedMs, latitude, longitude, horizontalAccuracy, speed, speedAccuracy, course, altitude, verticalAccuracy, provider, isMock`. Negative numbers mean "unknown". |
| `StartConfig` | `engine, adaptiveSampling, batterySaver, sessionId, startSeq, startSegmentId, intervalMs, minDistanceMeters, notificationTitle, notificationText` (Swift memberwise order). |
| `NativeSnapshot` | `sessionId, state, segmentId, distance, fixCount, lastFixTimeMs, updatedAtMs, error`. |
| `TrackingHostApi`, `TrackingHostApiSetup` | The protocol `FlutterTrackingGpsPlugin` implements and the function that registers it. |
| `StreamFixesStreamHandler`, `StreamSnapshotsStreamHandler`, `PigeonEventSink` | The event channels that stream fixes and engine snapshots to Dart. |

## Related
